breakdown.description: Each CCD direction is paired with the opposite direction's `PROCAR` file instead of its own matching file.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the error from the incomplete prompt. It loads the PROCAR for the first configuration set (paired with ccd_0_-1 vaspruns) from 'v_Ga/ccd_-1_0/1/PROCAR' (the opposite directory), and the PROCAR for the second configuration set (paired with ccd_-1_0 vaspruns) from 'v_Ga/ccd_0_-1/1/PROCAR' (again the opposite directory). The ground truth requires each CCD direction to be paired with its own matching PROCAR file (ccd_0_-1 with ccd_0_-1/1/PROCAR, and ccd_-1_0 with ccd_-1_0/1/PROCAR). The inconsistency was not resolved.
